policy: Exact reviewed identities only. Wiki Item decisions override the five dated cache conflicts and two additional pet-token conflicts without changing raw flags. Literal Item IDs, canonical redirects and recorded cache names distinguish these tokens from NPC/Monster homonyms. Historical membership does not assert current acquisition. Virtual rewards and empty outcomes are typed separately. Custom catalogues never inherit this review.

entries.name: Ceremonial sword
entries.distinction: Retained ingredient represents sword creation, not purchasing the free Swordsmith reward upgrade.

entries.name: Runes for Slayer Dart
entries.distinction: A reward bundle, not a spell or a physical item. Spell membership cannot ban its free component runes.

entries.name: Slayer XP
entries.distinction: Experience is not an inventory item; free Slayer training stops at level 5. Reward-source availability remains a separate source policy.
